# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

tariff_data = data['tariff_rates']['data']
trade_data = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
supply_data = data['supply_chain_share']['data']
events_data = data['policy_events']['data']

# --- Editorial color palette ---
C_US_TARIFF = '#B22234'      # deep red (US tariff)
C_CN_TARIFF = '#DE7A22'      # burnt orange (China tariff)
C_TRADE_TOTAL = '#1B3A5C'    # navy (bilateral trade total)
C_EXPORTS = '#5B8DB8'        # medium blue (US exports)
C_IMPORTS = '#1B3A5C'        # navy (US imports)
C_CHINA_SHARE = '#B22234'    # red (China share declining)
C_VIETNAM = '#2E8B57'        # sea green
C_INDIA = '#DAA520'          # goldenrod
C_EVENT_LINE = '#555555'
C_BG = '#FAFAF7'
C_GRID = '#E0DDD5'
C_TEXT = '#2C2C2C'

# Period -> numeric x position for tariff timeline
period_labels = [d['period'] for d in tariff_data]
period_x = np.arange(len(period_labels))
us_tariff = [d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff_data]
cn_tariff = [d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff_data]

# Bilateral trade
trade_years = [d['year'] for d in trade_data]
exports = [d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in trade_data]
imports = [d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in trade_data]
total_trade = [d['total_bilateral'] for d in trade_data]

# Supply chain share
sc_years = [d['year'] for d in supply_data]
china_share = [d['china'] for d in supply_data]
vietnam_share = [d['vietnam'] for d in supply_data]
india_share = [d['india'] for d in supply_data]

# Policy events mapping to tariff period x-axis
period_to_x = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(period_labels)}

# --- Figure setup: 3-panel vertical layout ---
fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3) = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(14, 16),
                                      gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [1.1, 0.9, 0.9],
                                                   'hspace': 0.32})
fig.patch.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics, 2016–2024',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT,
             x=0.07, ha='left', y=0.97)
fig.text(0.07, 0.952,
         'Tariff escalation, bilateral trade volumes, and supply chain diversification',
         fontsize=13, color='#666666', ha='left', style='italic')

# ============================================================
# PANEL 1: Tariff Escalation Timeline with Policy Annotations
# ============================================================
ax1.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Step-line for tariff rates
ax1.step(period_x, us_tariff, where='mid', color=C_US_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5,
         label='US tariff on Chinese goods', zorder=3)
ax1.step(period_x, cn_tariff, where='mid', color=C_CN_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5,
         label='China tariff on US goods', zorder=3)

# Fill under curves for visual weight
ax1.fill_between(period_x, us_tariff, step='mid', alpha=0.10, color=C_US_TARIFF, zorder=2)
ax1.fill_between(period_x, cn_tariff, step='mid', alpha=0.08, color=C_CN_TARIFF, zorder=2)

# Annotate policy events on the tariff panel
event_subset = [
    ("2017-H2", "Section 301\nInvestigation", "investigation"),
    ("2018-H1", "Section 301\nMemo signed", "tariff"),
    ("2018-H2", "Lists 1–3\n($250B)", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H1", "List 3\nraised to 25%", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H2", "List 4A\n($112B)", "tariff"),
    ("2020-H1", "Phase One\nDeal", "deal"),
    ("2021-H2", "USTR tariff\nreview", "review"),
    ("2024-H1", "Biden raises\ntariffs (EVs,\nsemis, steel)", "tariff"),
]

event_colors = {
    'investigation': '#7B68EE',
    'tariff': C_US_TARIFF,
    'deal': '#2E8B57',
    'review': '#5B8DB8',
}

y_offsets = [28, 30, 28, 30, 28, 28, 28, 30]

for i, (period, label, cat) in enumerate(event_subset):
    x = period_to_x[period]
    ax1.axvline(x, color=event_colors[cat], alpha=0.35, linewidth=1.0,
                linestyle='--', zorder=1)
    yoff = y_offsets[i]
    ax1.annotate(label, xy=(x, yoff), fontsize=7.5, ha='center',
                 color=event_colors[cat], fontweight='bold',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white',
                           edgecolor=event_colors[cat], alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax1.set_xticks(period_x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(period_labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9, color=C_TEXT)
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Panel A — Tariff Escalation Timeline', loc='left',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=10)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 35)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%g%%'))
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax1.grid(axis='x', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.4, linestyle=':', zorder=0)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax1.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT)

# Legend

                  edgecolor=C_GRID, framealpha=0.9)
leg1.get_frame().set_facecolor(C_BG)

# ============================================================
# PANEL 2: Bilateral Trade Volume (stacked bar chart)
# ============================================================
ax2.set_facecolor(C_BG)

bar_width = 0.55
bar_x = np.arange(len(trade_years))

ax2.bar(bar_x, imports, bar_width, label='US Imports from China',
        color=C_IMPORTS, zorder=3, alpha=0.85)
ax2.bar(bar_x, exports, bar_width, bottom=imports,
        label='US Exports to China', color=C_EXPORTS, zorder=3, alpha=0.85)

# Overlay total line
ax2.plot(bar_x, total_trade, color='#333333', linewidth=2, marker='o',
         markersize=5, zorder=4, label='Total Bilateral Trade')

# Value labels on total
for i, v in enumerate(total_trade):
    ax2.annotate(f'${v:.0f}B', xy=(bar_x[i], v + 8),
                 fontsize=8, ha='center', color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

# Shade the peak-tariff dip region (2019-2020)

                                      gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [1.1, 0.9, 0.9],
                                                   'hspace': 0.32})
fig.patch.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics, 2016–2024',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT,
             x=0.07, ha='left', y=0.97)
fig.text(0.07, 0.952,
         'Tariff escalation, bilateral trade volumes, and supply chain diversification',
         fontsize=13, color='#666666', ha='left', style='italic')

# ============================================================
# PANEL 1: Tariff Escalation Timeline with Policy Annotations
# ============================================================
ax1.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Step-line for tariff rates
ax1.step(period_x, us_tariff, where='mid', color=C_US_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5,
         label='US tariff on Chinese goods', zorder=3)
ax1.step(period_x, cn_tariff, where='mid', color=C_CN_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5,
         label='China tariff on US goods', zorder=3)

# Fill under curves for visual weight
ax1.fill_between(period_x, us_tariff, step='mid', alpha=0.10, color=C_US_TARIFF, zorder=2)
ax1.fill_between(period_x, cn_tariff, step='mid', alpha=0.08, color=C_CN_TARIFF, zorder=2)

# Annotate policy events on the tariff panel
event_subset = [
    ("2017-H2", "Section 301\nInvestigation", "investigation"),
    ("2018-H1", "Section 301\nMemo signed", "tariff"),
    ("2018-H2", "Lists 1–3\n($250B)", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H1", "List 3\nraised to 25%", "tariff"),
    ("2019-H2", "List 4A\n($112B)", "tariff"),
    ("2020-H1", "Phase One\nDeal", "deal"),
    ("2021-H2", "USTR tariff\nreview", "review"),
    ("2024-H1", "Biden raises\ntariffs (EVs,\nsemis, steel)", "tariff"),
]

event_colors = {
    'investigation': '#7B68EE',
    'tariff': C_US_TARIFF,
    'deal': '#2E8B57',
    'review': '#5B8DB8',
}

y_offsets = [28, 30, 28, 30, 28, 28, 28, 30]

for i, (period, label, cat) in enumerate(event_subset):
    x = period_to_x[period]
    ax1.axvline(x, color=event_colors[cat], alpha=0.35, linewidth=1.0,
                linestyle='--', zorder=1)
    yoff = y_offsets[i]
    ax1.annotate(label, xy=(x, yoff), fontsize=7.5, ha='center',
                 color=event_colors[cat], fontweight='bold',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white',
                           edgecolor=event_colors[cat], alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.6))

ax1.set_xticks(period_x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(period_labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9, color=C_TEXT)
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Panel A — Tariff Escalation Timeline', loc='left',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=10)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 35)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%g%%'))
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax1.grid(axis='x', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.4, linestyle=':', zorder=0)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax1.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT)

# Legend
leg1 = ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, frameon=True, fancybox=False,
                  edgecolor=C_GRID, framealpha=0.9)
leg1.get_frame().set_facecolor(C_BG)

# ============================================================
# PANEL 2: Bilateral Trade Volume (stacked bar chart)
# ============================================================
ax2.set_facecolor(C_BG)

bar_width = 0.55
bar_x = np.arange(len(trade_years))

ax2.bar(bar_x, imports, bar_width, label='US Imports from China',
        color=C_IMPORTS, zorder=3, alpha=0.85)
ax2.bar(bar_x, exports, bar_width, bottom=imports,
        label='US Exports to China', color=C_EXPORTS, zorder=3, alpha=0.85)

# Overlay total line
ax2.plot(bar_x, total_trade, color='#333333', linewidth=2, marker='o',
         markersize=5, zorder=4, label='Total Bilateral Trade')

# Value labels on total
for i, v in enumerate(total_trade):
    ax2.annotate(f'${v:.0f}B', xy=(bar_x[i], v + 8),
                 fontsize=8, ha='center', color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

# Shade the peak-tariff dip region (2019-2020)
idx_2019 = trade_years.index(2019)
idx_2020 = trade_years.index(2020)
ax2.axvspan(idx_2019 - 0.4, idx_2020 + 0.4, alpha=0.08, color=C_US_TARIFF, zorder=1)
ax2.text((idx_2019 + idx_2020) / 2, 55, 'Peak tariff\nperiod', fontsize=8,
         ha='center', color=C_US_TARIFF, fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_xticks(bar_x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(trade_years, fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax2.set_ylabel('Trade Volume (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Panel B — US-China Bilateral Trade Volume', loc='left',

ax2.set_ylim(0, 770)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%g B'))
ax2.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax2.spines['bottom'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax2.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT)

leg2 = ax2.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, frameon=True, fancybox=False,
                  edgecolor=C_GRID, framealpha=0.9)
leg2.get_frame().set_facecolor(C_BG)

# ============================================================
# PANEL 3: Supply Chain Diversion (area chart / line chart)
# ============================================================
ax3.set_facecolor(C_BG)

sc_x = np.arange(len(sc_years))

# China declining share
ax3.plot(sc_x, china_share, color=C_CHINA_SHARE, linewidth=2.5, marker='s',
         markersize=6, label='China', zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_x, china_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_CHINA_SHARE, zorder=2)

# Vietnam rising
ax3.plot(sc_x, vietnam_share, color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=2.5, marker='^',
         markersize=6, label='Vietnam', zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_x, vietnam_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_VIETNAM, zorder=2)

# India rising
ax3.plot(sc_x, india_share, color=C_INDIA, linewidth=2.5, marker='D',
         markersize=5, label='India', zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_x, india_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_INDIA, zorder=2)

# Annotate the post-2018 acceleration: vertical line at 2018
idx_2018 = sc_years.index(2018)
ax3.axvline(idx_2018, color=C_EVENT_LINE, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax3.annotate('Trade war\nescalation\nbegins', xy=(idx_2018 + 0.1, 19.5),
             fontsize=8.5, color=C_EVENT_LINE, fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic',
             ha='left')

# Arrow annotation for China decline
ax3.annotate('', xy=(sc_x[-1], china_share[-1]), xytext=(sc_x[2], china_share[2]),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_CHINA_SHARE, lw=1.5,
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15', alpha=0.5))
ax3.text(sc_x[-1] + 0.15, china_share[-1] - 0.3, f'{china_share[-1]}%', fontsize=9,
         color=C_CHINA_SHARE, fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax3.text(sc_x[-1] + 0.15, vietnam_share[-1] - 0.1, f'{vietnam_share[-1]}%', fontsize=9,
         color=C_VIETNAM, fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax3.text(sc_x[-1] + 0.15, india_share[-1] - 0.1, f'{india_share[-1]}%', fontsize=9,
         color=C_INDIA, fontweight='bold', va='center')

# Show delta annotations
china_delta = china_share[-1] - china_share[2]  # 2018 to 2024
vn_delta = vietnam_share[-1] - vietnam_share[2]
in_delta = india_share[-1] - india_share[2]

delta_text = f'Since 2018:  China {china_delta:+.1f}pp  |  Vietnam {vn_delta:+.1f}pp  |  India {in_delta:+.1f}pp'
ax3.text(0.5, 0.03, delta_text, transform=ax3.transAxes, fontsize=9.5,
         ha='center', color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold',

                   alpha=0.9))

ax3.set_xticklabels(sc_years, fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax3.set_ylabel('Share of Total US Imports (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Panel C — Supply Chain Diversification: US Import Shares', loc='left',

ax3.set_ylim(0, 25)
ax3.set_xlim(-0.3, len(sc_years) - 0.3)
ax3.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%g%%'))

ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['left'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax3.spines['bottom'].set_color(C_GRID)
ax3.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT)

                  edgecolor=C_GRID, framealpha=0.9)
leg3.get_frame().set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Source footnote
fig.text(0.07, 0.006,
         'Source: US Census Bureau, USTR, Peterson Institute for International Economics  |  2024 data partial/estimated',
         fontsize=8, color='#999999', ha='left')
